crossRefs.note: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of…
Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: They found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful; for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.
translations.bsb: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
translations.kjv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
translations.asv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they that dwelt there aforetime were of Ham.
